full_page.content:
1932, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 68 Cont.
Oct. Ed. Ruane - 38 - no work, no support for wife & 3 small children Wife pronounced T.B. last month - asked PP. is pronounced O.K. Mrs. Anna Schnell - 38 - arthritis.
Oct. 4 Rose Storey - 38 - Nurse in Harper - Bro. a priest acute, cancer of throat. Operation surprisingly successful. Everyone concerned won- dering Saturday Oct. 8th.
Lillian Young about 20 - 4 yrs. on her back with T.B. Enrolled 2 yr. ago now O.K. only voice weak.
Edw'd Wesley - 3 - convulsions since 4 mo. old better for time - while parents were receiving weekly on promise for 6 m .....
Baby Richard Krellwitz 11 mo. mastoid
Sister M. Norbert - I.H.M. - liver & nervous - gall removed.
Mary born - 49 - down - crutches 15 mo.
Rebecca Williams - non C. - 22 - of Pittsburgh, Penn. - fell 2 yrs. ago hurt her spine and is paralysed ever since. Enrolled this a.m. after being on road since yesterday.
Mrs. Anthe - 52 - Foster son - wayward. ....
Mrs. Voigt - Chr. Scientist - 8 yrs. widow - had nursed invalid hus- band 14 yrs. - 1.00 en.
Mrs. Rose Carpenter & Family
Blank Page
Page 69 Page 70 Oct. David McInerney ... Ep'tic Fits
Stanley Stein ... Ep'tic Fits had togive up trying to join brothers Mrs. A. Sullivan - 52 - sickly for 5 yrs. - serious operation to- morrow. Fears she can't get well.
Marie Elliott sore mouth.
George Hild - 6 - operation
